title: P2LRN Multipart Payload Profile
description: Allows a large logical representation payload to remain owned and hosted by the package publisher while being split into integrity-verified adjacent parts.
rules: Multipart is a transport profile and MUST NOT change the semantic profile or media type of the logical representation.
A multipart representation MUST carry the https://p2lrn.org/profile/multipart extension and MUST point to an embedded application/vnd.p2lrn.multipart+json descriptor.

When a representation is a view of one member inside the reconstructed package, the multipart extension MAY declare a safe relative member path; this replaces package-member transport without changing the representation media type.
Every part href MUST be a safe relative path resolved against the URL of the outer .p2lrn package; multipart MUST NOT require upload to the P2LRN CDN.
Each part MUST declare its exact byte size and SHA-256 byte digest.
The descriptor MUST declare the logical payload total size and SHA-256 digest, and the ordered part sizes MUST sum exactly to the total size.
A reader MUST verify each part before accepting it and MUST verify the concatenated logical payload before handing it to a renderer.
Multipart parts are operational files owned by the package publisher and are not entries inside the outer ZIP container.
A reader MUST fail closed when a part is missing, reordered, truncated, oversized or has a digest mismatch.
